date.as_written: iṣṭaṃ vedahataṃ caturdaśayu(7)taṃ paṃcāhataṃ vedayuk taṣṭaṃ (!) khendumiterbhaved dinam atho siddhānvitaṃ syāt tibhiḥ || (!) vyekaṃ bhaṃ dhṛtihīnayogamitakaiḥ sūryatrighātaṃ yutaṃ śāko

notes: The colophon concludes with an astronomical/mathematical riddle in verse to find the Śaka date (śāka) of copying the Triśatikā (Pāṭī), but names no human individuals.
